get.description:
This API retrieves the business associated with a given `book_uuid`. It returns the business ID and display name, which can be used with business-level endpoints to access aggregated data across multiple <<glossary:Book>>s. 
A single business can have multiple Books. All books associated with the same business within your organization return the same business ID.

parameters.name: book_uuid
parameters.description: A universally unique identifier (UUID) of the Book used to retrieve its associated business.

id.description: Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the business entity. This is a stable identifier that is used with all business endpoints.

name.description: Display name of the business. The name is determined in the following order: user-defined display name, org-specific name, then global entity name.

403.description: Book not associated with requesting organization

404.description: Business Identity Not Associated With Book

get.description: This API retrieves the full metadata profile for a business entity, including industry classification, loan inquiry history, and addresses derived from bank account holder information.

parameters.name: business_id
parameters.description: A universally unique identifier (UUID) of the business entity for which you want to retrieve overview information.

id.description: UUID of the business entity for which overview information is retrieved.

name.description: Display name of the business. The name is determined in the following order: user-defined display name, org-specific name, then global entity name.

state.description: Current operational state of the business entity.

industry.description: Industry classification information for the business.

naics4_code.description: A 4-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code that represents the industry of the Book.

naics_description.description:
The description of the 4-digit NAICS code, indicating the industry classification of the Book category.

  > 📘 In Books with multiple businesses or fragmented merchant activity, system may show the following statuses as applicable:
  > - **`Pending - Industry Data`** — Classification is in progress.  
  > - **`Unable to find a unique SMB merchant`** — The system is not able to find a unique merchant mapped to the documents in the Book.  
  > - **`Not Available`** — The system has found a unique merchant, but this merchant does not have industry classification data.

naics6_code.description: A six-digit NAICS code that provides a more granular industry classification for the merchant. This code refines the broader NAICS category and is commonly used for detailed industry analysis, peer comparisons, and benchmarking.

naics6_description.description: A human-readable description of the six-digit NAICS code that specifies the merchant’s exact industry segment within the broader NAICS classification.

naics_override.description: Shows if the 4-digit NAICSA code was overriden by the lender.

mcc_code.description: A four-digit code assigned by payment networks that classifies a merchant based on the primary type of goods or services they provide. Merchant Category Code (MCC) are commonly derived from card transaction data and are used for transaction categorization, risk assessment, and analytics.

mcc_description_.description: A human-readable description of the MCC that explains the merchant’s primary business activity as defined by the card network.

sic_code.description: A four-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code that identifies the merchant’s primary business activity using the legacy SIC system. SIC codes are derived from bank statement data and are used for industry classification, regulatory reporting, and analytics.

sic_description_.description: A human-readable description of the SIC code that explains the merchant’s primary industry classification under the SIC system.

active_override.description: Shows if the industry classification has been manually overridden.

loan_inquiries.description: Loan inquiry history and velocity metrics aggregated across all applications.

total_applications.description: Total number of loan applications across all organisations that have been made for this business entity.

application_history.description:
Timestamps (ISO 8601) for each application.
  > 📘 Note
  > This is cross-org data. It includes application timestamps but does not identify which organization submitted each application.

velocity.description: Application velocity counts in rolling time windows.

day_count_30.description: Number of applications in the last 30 days.

day_count_60.description: Number of applications in the last 60 days.

day_count_90.description: Number of applications in the last 90 days.

day_count_180.description: Number of applications in the last 180 days.

day_count_270.description: Number of applications in the last 270 days.

day_count_365.description: Number of applications in the last 365 days.

addresses.description: Deduplicated addresses derived from bank account holder information, sorted by frequency with the most common address first.

holder_address_1.description: The primary line of the address, typically including the street number and name.

holder_address_2.description: The secondary line of the address, which may include apartment, suite, unit, building, or floor.

holder_city.description: The city associated with the address.

holder_state.description: The state or province associated with the address.

holder_zip.description: The postal or ZIP code associated with the address.

holder_country.description: The country associated with the address.

frequency.description: Number of bank accounts sharing this address. Higher frequency indicates higher confidence.

status.description: A numerical code that indicates the status of the request.

code.description: A numerical code that indicates the nature of an error.

response.description: An object received from the server that potentially contains data.

message.description: A textual description that indicates details about this response's status.

get.description:
This API retrieves the paginated, deduplicated enriched transactions across all of the requesting org's <<glossary:Book>>s for a given business. Transactions are structurally compatible with the existing book-level enriched transactions API.

  > 👍 Tips
  > `start_date` and `end_date` filter transactions based on when they occurred at the bank, while `updated_since` filters based on when transactions were ingested into the system. Use `updated_since` to retrieve newly added data, even if the transaction dates are earlier.

parameters.name: business_id
parameters.description: A universally unique identifier (UUID) of the business entity for which you want to retrieve transction details.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of transactions to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return per page, starting from the specified **offset**.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format from which you want to filter transactions. The system includes only transactions with a `txn_date` on or after the specified date.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format from which you want to filter transactions. The system includes only transactions with a `txn_date` on or before the specified date.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) for filtering transactions ingested into the system after this time. The system uses `txn_created_ts` to determine the ingestion time. Use this for incremental retrieval to fetch only newly ingested transactions since your last request.

id.description: Unique identifier of the business entity for which transaction details are retrieved.

total.description: The total number of deduplicated transactions for this business retrieved based on the specified query parameteres.

filtered_total.description: The total number of transactions retrieved based on the provided `start_date`, `end_date`, and `updated_since` filters.

offset.description: The starting index for paginated transactions result.

limit.description: The maximum number of transactions returned per page starting from the specified `offset` value.

txn_date.description: Date of the transaction in ISO 8601-compliant YYYY-MM-DD format.

description.description: A brief description of the transaction.

bank_account_pk.description: The primary key of the bank account associated with the transaction.

uploaded_doc_uuid.description: The UUID of the uploaded <<glossary:Document>> containing transaction details.

uploaded_doc_name.description: The name of the uploaded <<glossary:Document>> containing transaction details.

amount.description:
Transaction amount. Positive values represent credits, and negative values represent debits.
This amount includes dollars and cents; to avoid floating-point precision errors, consider parsing this field with a decimal data type, as opposed to a native `float` or `double`.

counterparty.description: Standardized identifier of the transaction counterparty.

comment.description: User provided notes or remarks about the transaction.

is_noteworthy.description: Indicates whether the transaction is considered noteworthy based on internal business rules and risk factors. A value of `true` highlights transactions that may require additional attention or review.

page_idx.description: The page number in the source document where this transaction was recorded.

book_uuid.description: UUID of the book entity from which transaction details are retrieved.

revenue.description: Deposits that have been included in revenue.

expense.description: Withdrawals that have been included as expense.

bank.description: Transaction associated with a traditional bank/depository institution.

bank_branch.description: Transaction with a physical bank branch.

bank_cash_advance.description: Cash advance transaction with a traditional bank.

bank_loan.description: Loan transaction with a traditional bank.

card_rewards.description: Transaction associated with credit card rewards.

checks.description: Transaction associated with check payments, including check payments that have cleared, as well as check payments that have not cleared but are present in the bank statement data.

credit_builder.description: Transaction associated with credit builder products offered by fintech companies to help businesses build credit history.

credit_card.description: Transaction associated with credit cards, including purchases, payments, fees, and interest charges.

crypto.description: Transaction associated with cryptocurrency and related companies.

debt_consolidator.description: Transaction associated with debt refinancing and consolidation companies that offer services to help businesses manage and consolidate existing debts.

equipment_lease.description: Transaction associated with equipment leasing companies.

federal_tax.description: Transaction associated with federal tax payments or refunds.

fintech_loan.description: Loan transaction with a fintech company that does not fit into `bank_loan` category.

fintech_loan_source.description: The source of a loan transaction with a fintech company.

fintech_mca.description: Merchant cash advance transaction with a fintech company.

fintech_mca_source.description: The source of a merchant cash advance transaction with a fintech company.

fintech.description: Transaction associated with a fintech company.

gambling.description: Transaction associated with gambling like casino and lottery.

insurance.description: Transaction associated with insurance premiums or payouts.

internal_transfer.description: Transfer between accounts with the same owner.

investment.description: Transaction associated with investment and brokerage companies.

large_deposits.description: Large amount of deposite in the account.

merchant_service_transfer.description: Transfer to/from a merchant service company.

merchant_service.description: Transaction associated with payment processing companies.

nsf_paid_or_negative_balance.description: Indicates a paid transaction despite insufficient funds (NSF) or an account with a negative balance.

nsf_returned_or_not_paid.description: Indicates a transaction that was returned or declined due to non-sufficient funds (NSF) and was not successfully paid.

other_loan.description: Loan transaction that does not fit into `fintech_loan` or `bank_loan`.

other_transfer.description: Transfer that does not fit into other categories.

paypal.description: Transaction with PayPal, including PayPal payments, fees, and refunds.

payroll_tax.description: Transaction associated with payroll tax payments or refunds.

payroll.description: Transaction associated with payroll activities and companies.

probable_recurring_txns.description: Transaction that is likely to be recurring based on internal business rules and transaction patterns.

remote.description: Transaction initiated without the physical presence of a card, such as online or phone transactions.

returned_item.description: Transaction associated with returned items, including returns of purchases and returned checks.

revenue_deduction_other.description: Transaction that had been removed from revenue but does not fit into other categories.

revenue_deduction.description: Transaction that has been removed from revenue, including refunds, returns, and other revenue adjustments.

reversed.description: Transaction that has been reversed, meaning the original transaction was negated by a subsequent transaction, such as a refund or reversal entry.

sba.description: Transaction associated with the Small Business Administration.

state_tax.description: Transaction associated with state tax payments or refunds.

tolls.description: Transaction associated with transportation tolls (bridges, highways, etc.).

truck_stop.description: Transaction associated with truck stops, including fuel purchases, rest fees, and other services at truck stop locations.

venmo_zelle_cashapp.description: Transaction with popular peer-to-peer payment platforms like Venmo, Zelle, and Cash App.

wire_transfer.description: Transaction associated with wire transfers, including both domestic and international wires.

custom_tag.description: Custom tag that can be applied to transactions based on user-defined criteria or business rules.
